text_block_list.name: Verxina's LANE
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't recovered from my fatigue yet, 
so please allow me to rest for a short 
while."

text_block_list.name: Verxina's LANE
text_block_list.text:
"I will return shortly, so please do not 
worry. Please take this opportunity to get 
some rest, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That LANE message arrived the day after we 
went to spectate the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The toll from that fierce battle in the 
Shuka Sho clearly still lingered; on the 
way back from observing, she looked 
somewhat pale. But..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to believe her own words that she 
would "be right back." Because—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I want to run more. To become stronger... 
and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Why... Won't you move...?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: A-Are you all right?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ? Shion-san...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Did you say it won't move...!? A-Are you 
injured!? Someone call an ambulance...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I'm not hurt. Nothing hurts at all, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, r-really?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Jumping to conclusions, huh. 
Still... what a relief.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Um, are you doing your training outside 
today too, Shion-san?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... I'm, in rehab right now, so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, why, umm... Put simply, well...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like she was interested in 
Verxina-san, or something...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I know I probably look pretty... 
unreliable from the outside, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If you're feeling off somehow, I'll stick 
with you... until we figure out why.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"If it's just that much... even I should 
be able to do it, right?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Shion-san...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—I see... So ever since the Japan Cup, you 
haven't been able to run well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
There really is nothing wrong with my 
body. I even got examined. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe it's... like, a mental thing, ya 
know?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: My mental state...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
At least, that's how it was for me... An 
overwhelming presence stood in front of 
me, blocking the way...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much, how much, how much, 
how much... No matter how hard I try...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
When you're made to think, "There's no way 
I can ever beat this person"—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I heard it. Clear as day... the sound 
of a heart breaking.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufu... Oh, honestly. What are you 
saying...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Verxina-san...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Me, breaking? ...That is utterly out of 
the question!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I am strong... My ability is second to 
none, not even to her!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I must stand at the pinnacle. Breaking 
down is simply—unthinkable!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Verxina-san... That's... no good.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...If I don't look closely, I'll just... 
sink deeper—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One evening. Cheval Grand visited the 
Trainer's Office, accompanied by Win 
Variation and Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Cheval Grand heard from Win 
Variation that she wanted to talk about 
Verxina, and came over with her younger 
sister.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—And that's where the conversation ended. 
At least, that's my personal take on it...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san... She's being pushed pretty 
hard, I think.
choice_data_list: I see... Thank you for telling me.
I see... Thanks for telling me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis... I had no idea at all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"That day, I was... so caught up in the 
excitement of that amazing race... that I 
couldn't see a thing."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I thought there was no way... 
that Big Sis would ever break...
choice_data_list: I'm... a failure of a Trainer too.
I'm a failure as a Trainer too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having watched her stand back up time and 
time again, I knew how strong-willed she 
was... or perhaps I had only assumed I 
did.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, hold on a second! There's no way 
things would ever get that awkward~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister is feeling down, right? Then we 
just gotta cheer her up!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If Cheval-chi and I give you a big hug, 
everything's gonna be just fine♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the source of Verxina's strength 
has always been her sisters. Their trust 
could very well help her stand back up.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'll LANE them~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big siiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what's up, Vivlos? Calling me out 
like this out of nowhere—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Cheval and Trainer too? 
...Seriously, what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "It's okay, Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos eagerly leaped at Verxina. It was a 
sight I had seen many times before. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You see, Big Sis is super-duper strong! 
She's always so sparkling, and so cool!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—You're my pride and joy, the strongest 
big sister ever! So everything's gonna be 
just fine! Right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Sis?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Uh... Yes. That's right, I'm fine... 
Because...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I'm, fine. Because...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because Big Sis is... more than anyone... 
more than ANYONE...—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ......I am sorry.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...! Even though... 
I'm the big sister...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“Still, no more... than this...! ...I 
just... can't—”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big... sis...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No one could utter another word. Seeing 
the ever-resolute Verxina so completely 
weakened... was just that shocking—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, Verxina contacted me. She said 
things had settled down for now, but... 
there still seemed to be a shadow behind 
her smile—
